Frisco, Colorado · 9,100 ft

     
A mining town on Lake Dillon

     
Frisco is a small, walkable town wrapped by the Tenmile Range, with Lake Dillon at the end of Main Street. Its 1880s cabins and storefronts still line the street, now home to cafés, breweries and gear shops. In winter it is a snowy base camp for six ski resorts; in summer the lake fills with paddleboards and sailboats.

     
    
      
  • Copper Mountain ~7 min · Breckenridge ~15 min
    • 
      
  • Denver International Airport ~95 miles
    • 
      
  • Free Summit Stage bus to the resorts
    • 
     

     Explore Frisco
    

    

     
Midway, Utah · Heber Valley

     
Utah's Little Switzerland

     
Swiss settlers arrived in Midway in the mid-1800s, and the town still shows it in its chalet-style buildings, its bakery and its Swiss Days festival in late summer. Green pastures sit under the Wasatch peaks, and the Homestead Crater lets you swim in mineral water around 95°F inside a limestone dome. Soldier Hollow, next door, hosted events of the 2002 Winter Olympics.

     
    
      
  • Park City and Deer Valley in under 30 minutes
    • 
      
  • Salt Lake City airport in under an hour
    • 
      
  • Sundance Mountain Resort in under 30 minutes

About us

    
A family company from Doral, Florida

    
Hi, I'm Kerwin. My family and I started My Trust Home with a simple idea: own a few small places in the mountains, take care of them ourselves, and host people the way we like to be hosted when we travel.

    
Today that means a ski studio in Frisco, Colorado and a resort suite in Midway, Utah. We stay in them ourselves, we know the restaurants and the trails around them, and we're always happy to tell you what we'd do.

    
If you have a question before you book, write to me. I answer personally.
